delegation.scope: One-shot low-impact read-only OPPO A74 metadata audit and evidence-based Pixel 9a installation readiness design; no install or capture change.
allowed_actions: Read already existing, authorized OPPO app-local or device metadata once
Read physically available existing private archived source bytes without access bypass
Compute actual per-source byte counts SHA256 and sample quality metrics
Run offline negative fixtures on already available data
Return source-exact summary with scoped evidence gaps
prohibited_actions: No new capture run or worker, restart, stop, permission change
No Pixel installation or app update
No public raw phone samples or private paths
No Hostinger write, access escalation or credential echo
No R3 reopen, R9 replace, R11 interference

mission.question: Does the existing OPPO A74 capture possess independently checkable sensor/transport metadata and enough falsifiable evidence to consider the same application as a candidate on Google Pixel 9a?
deliverables: Source exact OPPO metadata and timebase register
Sensor continuity estimates and quality intervals
Device ZIP vs Hostinger actual bytes and package gaps
Null/alternative hypothesis and executed fixture register
Conditional Pixel app/OS/sensor compatibility and separate-authorization gate
Detached SHA256SUMS plus real Cursor return handshake
falsifiers: Missing original payload despite receipt MATCH
Resampled synthetic stream falsely labeled physical 100 Hz
Changing app signer, permissions, API behavior
Cross-device confirmation asserted before Pixel prospective data
acceptance_tests: Real source bytes and acquisition method per observed field
Actual negative controls execution segregated from proposed
No OPPO capture interference, no Pixel install
Independent receiver rehash remains pending until performed
pause_conditions: Not actually connected to OPPO or private archive
not_executed: Fresh OPPO read until Cursor actual receipt

provenance.copyright_privacy: Private device source bytes remain only private; public safe sanitized summary.

functionality_performance: Sampling rate, loss, jitter timebase honestly calculated
traceability_comprehensibility: Each value identified OBSERVED vs REPORTED vs INFERRED
Pixel gate separate from actual install
